published_ranges._nozzle_by_speed: 200C @ 24 mm3/s (Material Data Table); 198C @ 2-3 mm3/s, 20-30 mm/s (TDS, Ultimaker S5 profile)
published_ranges._hardened_nozzle_required: Hard steel nozzle + gears recommended (Material Data Table)
published_ranges._min_nozzle: Process may be less consistent on nozzles < 0.4 mm (TDS)
published_ranges._notes: Stainless steel filled PLA, about 2x the density of PLA. Slightly more brittle than PLA and more abrasive (wear-resistant and/or larger nozzle suggested); max particle 250 microns; min bend diameter 35 mm. Avoid printing below 3 mm3/s. Melt onset approx. 155C. fields low/high are the TDS and Material Data Table single values.
